consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: break
consultations.section: Short stop sense1 and Working life topic, lines106-155; separate school/general interruption and other noun senses
consultations.finding: The selected countable noun is a short pause during an activity, for rest, eating or similar needs. The selected topic label is A1. School recess, a longer career interruption, physical damage, an opening, a chance and sports uses are separate. British school break and North American recess do not become spelling alternatives for this workplace rest pause.

The regional contrast with extra time belongs to sport; it does not restrict the workplace noun. The source does not establish a legal rate, entitlement or authority to assign extra hours.

The North American take-attendance idiom and formal assistance idioms do not restrict the ordinary noun.
